title: New villages in the Crown of the Marches and Oakvale
changes: Five more villages stand along the highways: Lists End above the Tourney Grounds, Vigil's Rest under the Vigil Courts and Kneelstone by the Field of Statues in the Crown of the Marches, and Sawyer's End by the Cinder Scar and Furrowby above the Sunken Lake in Oakvale. Follow the signposted dirt paths off the road.
Each has a portal stone, a bounty board beside it, a villager with a short local quest, and someone to talk to or trade with. Lists End sells armour and Furrowby sells flasks.
Monsters stay out of the villages, and the clans can fight over them like the other villages: a held village adds half a town's income to its clan.
